fusions.name: Spore-Shaking Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes the first enemy in reach for 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Ring of Puffballs
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash in a circle that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, with a 50% chance to leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore Line Laid
fusions.desc: Lays a 6-tile line of spores along the lash's path for 8 seconds. Enemies who cross it are [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Welts
fusions.desc: Every hit you land plants a stack on the enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all burst at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
